title: Means of a skewed population
intro: Repair times from an exponential population with rate λ = 0.5 per hour (mean 2 h, σ = 2 h, strongly skewed). The Simulation drew 2000 samples of n = 30 (seed 1). Their means average 1.9834 h with a standard deviation of 0.3586 h, against μ = 2 and σ/√n = 0.3651, and their histogram follows the normal curve of the central limit theorem.
